summary: More grafana.grafana changes in Ansible 11: config.river renamed to config.alloy, check mode for the otel collector, unified and legacy alerting config by version, Alloy variables moved to the grafana_alloy_ namespace, grafana_plugins_ops, google_analytics_4_id, and octal mode lint fixes.
questions: Why were Alloy variables renamed to grafana_alloy_?
Does the alloy role use config.alloy instead of config.river?
How do I set google_analytics_4_id in the grafana role?
